blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. has declared special non-working days in seven localities across the country to allow residents to fully participate in their respective founding, charter or fiesta celebrations. Under Proclamation No. 1437, Sept. 21, Monday, is a special non-working day in Aguinaldo, Ifugao. The municipality marks its founding anniversary on Sept. 20, which falls on a Sunday. Upon the request of the Office of the Mayor, the holiday was moved to Sept. 21 to give residents the opportunity to fully celebrate the occasion.
